title: Benghuai: Xing Qiong Tiedao - Ting! Kuanghuan Zaina Shenyou de Shandian

alternative_titles.en: Honkai: Star Rail - Hark! There's Revelry Atop the Divine Mountain
alternative_titles.ja: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》动画短片：「听！狂欢在那神佑的山巅」

synopsis:
Do you still remember, Khaslana, the one who won't reach the dawn?

In that drunken dream, the mountains loomed high and steep — and there, you saw yourself.

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
